concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-braintree-control-panel-vault-create]] - Control Panel creation of a new Vault customer with or without a credit card, with separate transaction-time and API routes, verification guidance, and the credit-card-only, conditional-CVV and never-store-CVV boundaries
warnings: Keep creation of the Vault customer distinct from optionally storing a credit card with that customer; the page also permits creation without a payment method.
Do not turn the transaction-time Store in Vault route or the card-verification recommendation into evidence of transaction authorization, settlement or successful verification.
Preserve that the collected Control Panel route stores only credit-card payment methods, while other payment methods are routed to the separate API.
Preserve that CVV may be required depending on account setup but is never stored, and do not generalize the optional billing address beyond applicable configured AVS rules.
Treat the linked transaction, API, verification and AVS pages as navigation only unless separately read.
